WITH PlaylistCounts AS (
  SELECT p.PlaylistId, COUNT(pt.TrackId) AS TrackCount
  FROM Playlist p
  LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId
  GROUP BY p.PlaylistId
), CountsWithAverage AS (
  SELECT PlaylistId, TrackCount, AVG(TrackCount) OVER () AS AverageTrackCount
  FROM PlaylistCounts
)
SELECT PlaylistId,
       TrackCount,
       CAST(TrackCount AS REAL) / NULLIF(AverageTrackCount, 0) AS Ratio
FROM CountsWithAverage
ORDER BY Ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
